basis: Operational warm-season risk/cost policy, replacing literal historical-extreme envelope after owner challenge. Not an all-time occurrence or physical-impossibility bound.

earliest.note: Original interview with ADCNR chief marine biologist Kevin Anson gives June through earlyOctober; June1 minus14days = May18.

latest.precision: month only; retrospective firsthand seasonal account, no dated October event recovered
latest.note: Jake Markris says events sometimes extend into September and October. Do not label October31 an actual event date.

derivation: June1 minus14days = May18. Retain all of October conservatively for reported late events, then add14days = November14. 181 active days every year;184 off-days ordinary year,185 leap year.
limitations: Historical records are incomplete; no proof events are impossible outside this window.
No-report days and seasonal pauses are NOT clean negative observations.
Primary May table excludes exact winter days; continue source-backed boundary recovery during in-season research.
Winter reports are preserved, not disproved or reclassified as cold kills. No associated measured February temperature/DO established in reviewed report.
No validated universal water-temperature shutdown threshold established. Keep full in-season coverage; do not suppress based on one surface sensor.

cloud.implementation: December–April excluded by BYMONTH=5..11. Calendar-first prompt gate handles May1–17 and November15–30. Dawn Timing on November14 prepares next May18 dawn; preserves gate.
cloud.residual: Boundary-date automation invocations may perform the initial calendar check; no source retrieval or model work authorized.

desktop.scope: Canonical Jubilee burst plus paid vision pipeline, including its embedded alligator analysis/notifications. Independent near-live/security feeds unchanged.
desktop.installation: Install all four files from reviewed PR5 together after backing up current files; helper must be installed first. Validate an in-season full cycle and off-season guard with mocked time; verify local file hashes.

github_jobs: Existing non-LLM GitHub quality/ingestion workflow schedules not changed; they are not paid vision execution.

historical_winter_reports.note: May explicitly reports one February and one March 1959 event among 135 reports, 1946–1971. February16 archive date is a newspaper publication date, not verified event day.

physical_basis.finding: State agency describes warm stagnant water, organic oxygen demand, stratification and shoreward transport.
Cold water has greater oxygen solubility; temperature alone is not an impossibility test.
Mobile Bay hypoxia also observed in lateApril/earlyMay2019; offshore/channel hypoxia is not itself a verified shoreline Jubilee. Do not equate these outcomes or claim zero outside-season risk.

superseded_policies.reason: Historical outliers overweighted for routine operating policy; winter-inclusive policy rejected by owner.
